species.name: Crappie
why: Water 54°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 54°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
